io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.guide

Class CheatSheetSlimefunGuide

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.guide.SurvivalSlimefunGuide
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.guide.CheatSheetSlimefunGuide
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SlimefunGuideImplementation

    public class CheatSheetSlimefunGuide
extends SurvivalSlimefunGuide
    This is an admin-variant of the SurvivalSlimefunGuide which allows a Player to spawn in a SlimefunItem via click rather than showing their Recipe.
